description: Source code for an EEPROM emulator driver for the Zephyr RTOS, specifically emulating Atmel AT24 series EEPROMs over I2C.

methods.name: at24_emul_transfer
methods.description: Handles I2C transfer emulation for the AT24 EEPROM, supporting simple read/write operations.

methods.name: emul_atmel_at24_init
methods.description: Initializes the EEPROM emulator instance, setting up data structures and starting with an erased EEPROM.
